```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

```

```{r}
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")

gt(head(rhinovirus))

```

```{r}
health <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")

ggplot(health, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "purple") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("percentage") +
  ggtitle("Percentage of positive PCR test results for rhinovirus")
```
